content: Teduglutide has been observed to increase the plasma levels of alprazolam, carbamazepine, chlordiazepoxide, chlorpromazine, clonazepam, clonidine, clorazepate, colchicine, cyclosporine, diazepam, digoxin, disopyramide, ethosuximide, flecainide, fluphenazine, haloperidol, levothyroxine, lithium, lorazepam, loxapine, midazolam, minoxidil, oxazepam, phenytoin, pimozide, prazosin, primidone, procainamide, prochlorperazine, quinidine, sirolimus, tacrolimus, theophylline, thioridazine, thiothixene, trifluoperazine, and valproic acid. This effect is likely due to an increase in the absorption of concomitant orally administered medications. Caution is advised when co-administering teduglutide with drugs that require careful titration or have a narrow therapeutic index, as dose adjustments may be necessary. Close monitoring of drug levels and clinical response is recommended to ensure safety and efficacy.
